All your business payments. One place.

Mosaic brings payments from your accounting and payroll systems into one place. See what is due, choose how to fund it and pay without switching between platforms.

1. Consolidate

Bring all your payments into one view.

Mosaic imports bills, payroll and other payment obligations from the systems your business already uses.

No manual re-entry

Bills and payroll are imported automatically, ready to review and pay.

Connect your existing systems

Keep using your existing accounting and payroll software.

Always up to date

See new and updated payment obligations as they enter your systems.

2. Sync

Know what funds are available before you pay.

Connect your bank accounts, cards and credit facilities to see your available funding in one place.

All your funding sources

Secure, read-only access

Choose with confidence

Select a bank account, card or available credit facility.

Review and approve

Confirm the details and submit the payment without uploading bank files.

Automatically reconciled

Review, prepare and manage client payments from one advisor workspace, without signing in to each business separately.

Less time switching systems

Your questions, answered.

Which platforms do you connect to?

Mosaic is being built to connect with leading accounting, payroll and banking platforms used by Australian businesses. Available integrations will be confirmed as Mosaic moves towards launch.

Who holds my money?

Mosaic does not hold your funds. Payments are initiated from your selected funding source and sent through the relevant payment network or provider.

How does Mosaic see my balances?

Mosaic uses secure open banking connections to display balances from your linked accounts. Access is read-only and can be withdrawn at any time.

Can my accountant pay on my behalf?

You can invite your accountant or bookkeeper and control what they can see, prepare, approve or pay.

What can I pay by credit card?

Eligible supplier invoices, tax obligations, payroll and super payments can be funded by credit card. Available payment methods may vary by payment type.

Can I earn points when I pay?

You may earn points in accordance with your card issuer's rewards program. Eligibility and earn rates are determined by the issuer.
